scope: No-spend browser diagnostics; public discovery observations are time-limited, not submission authority. No real proofs or transactions were submitted.

kohaku.detail: Kohaku 0.0.1-alpha.30 WASM loaded in this browser.

walletIndependentInitialization.detail: In-memory provider built with an explicit RPC syncer; no signers registered, persistent databases opened, or RPC calls made.

indexedDb.detail: Production database adapter passed set/get/delete in a fresh diagnostic database; existing app databases are never opened.

utxoSync.detail: Real Kohaku UTXO sync completed with one injected empty log response at the deployment block. This is a mocked RPC fixture, not live mainnet history or a wallet balance.

nativeEthShieldConstruction.detail: Real alpha.30 ShieldBuilder produced RelayAdapt native-ETH calldata for one wei to a public unfunded test fixture. No account signs or submits it.

derivationCompatibility.detail: 4 public test vectors match the independently pinned reference addresses. No test wallet is saved or queried.

proofApi.detail: Public RailgunProvider.build and transfer/unshield builder APIs exist. No spendable notes or proof-generation success are claimed.

poiApi.detail: Kohaku alpha.30 exposes post-transaction POI processing, but no pre-transaction POI proof export for the broadcaster payload.

transactionBridge.detail: Mainnet transact ABI decoder preserves target, calldata, nullifiers and proof-bound parameters; required pre-POI and fee-output binding are unavailable.

submissionPayload.detail: No real broadcaster payload can be constructed without pre-transaction POI and a verified private fee output. Deterministic fixture tests cover serialization separately.
